# proxmox_metrics_export (Data Source)

Reads cluster metric points from `GET /cluster/metrics/export`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_metrics_export" "cluster" {
  node_list = "pve-1,pve-2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_list` (String) Comma separated node list.

### Optional

- `history` (Boolean) Also return historical points (the API limits history to roughly an hour).

### Read-Only

- `metrics` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `metric` (String)
- `timestamp` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (Number)
